summary: Bitzero Holdings Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on September 10, 2026, announcing the refiling of amended and restated annual and interim financial statements and MD&A. The refiled interim statements for the three and nine months ended June 30, 2026 replace those previously filed August 14, 2026, primarily clarifying and reorganizing presentation and disclosures without affecting total assets, liabilities, equity, net loss, comprehensive loss or cash. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch for restatement-related disclosure risk and any follow-on regulatory inquiry.
